Michiko Neya (Japanese: 根谷美智子 Neya Michiko) is a Japanese voice actress for . She was born on October 4, 1965 in , , .

==Pokémon roles==
Neya has been providing voices on and off for the series ever since . She has mostly played characters of the day.
